test_cases.name: German Cafe requests quote for ambiguous Rug item and clear Soda item
test_cases.description: A verbose customer email from German Cafe requesting a quote for a 'Rug' without specifying which of the multiple available Rug items, and also requesting a quote for Soda - Medium. The ambiguity in the Rug request requires clarification before a quote can be created.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Rug and Soda
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

We are looking to refresh some of our cafe decor and would like to request a quote for a rug suitable for our seating area. I noticed you offer several rugs, but I am not sure which would be best for our needs. Could you please provide pricing and availability details for your rug options? We are interested in something durable and easy to clean, but I do not have a specific model or item number in mind yet.

Additionally, please include a quote for 24 units of Soda - Medium, as listed in your catalog.

If there are any differences in shipment times or availability for the rugs, please let us know so we can plan accordingly.

Best regards,
German Cafe

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request with ambiguous item selection and missing shipment preference
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for building blocks, but refers to multiple candidate items in the catalog without specifying which one, and also requests a pizza without specifying the preferred shipment date or option. The email includes extra context and explanations, but leaves key details ambiguous, requiring the SOA to clarify before proceeding.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Building Blocks and Pizza
initial_turn.body:
Hi there,

I’m reaching out because we’re planning a small event for kids at our store next month, and I’d like to get a quote for a few items. First, we’re looking for some building blocks sets—something fun and educational, ideally suitable for kids aged 4-8. I noticed you carry both AdventureCraft Building Blocks and SmartToys Building Blocks, but I’m not sure which would be best for our needs. Could you let me know which one is more popular or recommended for group play? Also, if there are any differences in availability or shipment timing between the two, please let me know.

Additionally, we’d like to include pizza for the event. I saw you offer several types (Pizza, Item No: AITEM-0050, AITEM-0051, AITEM-0052), but I’m not sure which one would be available for delivery around the event date. Could you provide a quote for pizza as well, and let me know what shipment options are possible?

If you need more details, just ask! Thanks so much for your help.

Best,
Jessica Stone

Best regards,
Jessica Stone

test_cases.name: Ambiguous Quote Request for T-Shirts and Pizza
test_cases.description: A verbose, impatient customer from Toytopia requests a quote for T-Shirts and Pizza, but does not specify which T-Shirt variant is needed, creating ambiguity that requires SOA clarification before proceeding.

initial_turn.subject: Need Quote ASAP – T-Shirts and Pizza
initial_turn.body:
Hi,

I need a quote as soon as possible for some items for an upcoming event, and I don't have time for back-and-forth. Please quote me for 50 T-Shirts. You have several T-Shirts listed, and frankly, I don't have the patience to dig through your catalog to figure out which is which—just give me a price for your T-Shirts. Also, add 20 Pizza to the quote (the regular kind, not sure if you have different types, but I just want Pizza). I expect a quick turnaround on this, so don't delay. If you need anything else, let me know, but please don't make this more complicated than it needs to be.

Best regards,
Toytopia

test_cases.name: Ambiguous T-Shirt Quote Request with Multiple Candidate Items
test_cases.description: A customer requests a quote for T-Shirts, referencing prior context and not specifying which T-Shirt variant or preferred shipment timing, requiring the SOA to clarify which item and shipment option to quote.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for T-Shirts and Play Mat
initial_turn.body:
Hi,

Could you please send me a quote for T-Shirts (same as last time) and one Playlandia Colorful Play Mat? I need the T-Shirts in bulk, but I’m not sure which ones are available for earliest shipment right now. Let me know what options you have and the soonest you can ship.

Best regards,
Tom Martinez
